pages.text:
File 3
Listening 1
Nick
What do you do, Hannah?
Hannah
Me? Oh, I’m a student. I study French at Birmingham
University. But I have a job at weekends – on Saturday
and Sunday.
Nick
OK. So, what’s your job?
Hannah
I’m a shop assistant in a sandwich shop.
Nick
Is that fast food?
Hannah
No, it isn’t. Our sandwiches are very good. It’s a
vegetarian sandwich shop, so we have cheese
sandwiches and salad sandwiches, but we don’t have
meat sandwiches.
Nick
OK. Only sandwiches then?
Hannah
No. We have drinks, of course … tea, coffee, fruit juice,
but we don’t have beer or wine. And we have chocolate
and fruit.
Nick
Do you like your job?
Hannah
Oh, yes. I like it very much. I meet a lot of people and I
eat a lot of chocolate …
File 3
Listening 2
1
Lena
You’re English, Rob, aren’t you?
Rob
Yes.
Lena
So, do you have bacon and eggs for breakfast?
Rob
Er … No, I don’t. I have cereal and coffee. And fruit juice.
Lena
Oh.
2
Jamie
Do you speak English in your job, Maria?
Maria
No, I don’t. I teach Spanish. So, no.
Jamie
Oh, OK. Where do you work?
Maria
At the university in the centre, near the hospital.
3
Peter
What time do you start work today, Karen?
Karen
Today? Oh, in half an hour. At quarter past eight.
Peter
Well, hurry up and eat your breakfast then.
4
Sally
What do you do in the evenings, Tim?
Tim
In the evenings? Er … well, I listen to music and I read
books. I don’t watch TV or listen to the radio.
Sally
OK. Interesting.
5
Gary
Do you live near here?
Penny Yes, I do. I have a small house in the centre.
Gary
Oh, is it nice?
Penny Yes, it is. Do you want to come for dinner tomorrow?
